mediaWork.title: Bone Valley
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Investigative journalism examining the wrongful conviction of Leo Schofield for the 1987 murder of his wife Michelle in Polk County, Florida.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Hosted by Pulitzer Prize-winning author Gilbert King and produced by Lava for Good.
